evergreen-gallery.$description: Evergreen Gallery — Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

frost-white.$description: Frost White — Product card surfaces, text on dark sections — slightly warm off-white, never pure #fff

pewter-mist.$description: Pewter Mist — Hairline borders, card outlines, divider rules, ghost-button borders on light cards

onyx.$description: Onyx — Primary text on light cards, icon strokes, high-contrast detail

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate warm cream surface — contrast-pair companion to dark text on light cards

ink-shadow.$description: Ink Shadow — Deepest text on evergreen, near-black with green undertone — pairs with frost-white for AAA contrast

marquee-cobalt.$description: Marquee Cobalt — Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ember-lacquer.$description: Ember Lacquer — Vivid red-orange seen in product photography (lacquered shelf units) — decorative, not functional

chalet-londonsixty.$description: Primary body and UI typeface — all nav links, product names, prices, badge text, footer copy, button labels. A custom rounded serif with distinctive ball terminals; its single weight is used universally

chalet-newyorksixty.$description: Secondary serif variant for body and link micro-copy — visually similar to LondonSixty but used in narrower contexts (small body, secondary links)

supremell-bold.$description: Display and heading typeface — exclusively carries section headings ("What's on: Bestsellers…"), the hero wordmark, and large UI moments. A sharp geometric sans that cuts against the serif body type. The massive 80px size with -0.02em tracking is the signature move

supremell-boldflat.$description: Flat-cut variant of the display sans for inline link emphasis within body copy
